# telnyx_email_inboxes (Data Source)

Lists email inboxes, with optional filters. Each item has the attributes of `telnyx_email_inbox`.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `max_items` (Number) Stop reading after this many items. By default every page is read.

### Read-Only

- `email_inboxes` (Attributes List) The objects, in the order the API returns them. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--email_inboxes))

<a id="nestedatt--email_inboxes"></a>
### Nested Schema for `email_inboxes`

Read-Only:

- `address` (String)
- `created_at` (String)
- `domain` (String) Domain name used by the inbox address.
- `domain_id` (String)
- `id` (String)
- `record_type` (String)
- `settings` (String) A JSON document; use `jsondecode()` to read it.
- `status` (String)
- `updated_at` (String)
